description: Implement webhook admin API for CRUD operations and log queries. All endpoints require operator auth. Follows existing admin.go patterns with OperatorGuard protection.
steps: 1. Create engine/internal/httpapi/webhook_admin.go with webhookAdmin struct and mount method. Define request/response types: createWebhookRequest (name, secretRef, provider, flowId, mapping, filter), updateWebhookRequest (same fields, all optional), webhookResponse (id, name, provider, flowId, mapping, filter, version, active).
2. Implement GET /admin/webhooks handler (listWebhooks): call store.ListWebhooks, return array of webhooks with version info. Redact any sensitive fields using observ.Redactor.
3. Implement GET /admin/webhooks/{id} handler (getWebhook): call store.GetWebhook, return single webhook config. Return 404 if not found.

4. Implement POST /admin/webhooks handler (createWebhook): validate request (name required, secretRef required, flowId required, provider defaults to 'generic'), call store.CreateWebhook, return 201 with webhook id and version.
5. Implement PUT /admin/webhooks/{id} handler (updateWebhook): validate request, call store.UpdateWebhook (creates new version), return updated webhook.
6. Implement DELETE /admin/webhooks/{id} handler (deleteWebhook): call store.DeleteWebhook (soft delete by removing from active_pointers), return 204 No Content.

7. Implement GET /admin/webhooks/{id}/logs handler (getWebhookLogs): accept query params (limit, offset, status filter), call store.GetWebhookLogs, return array of log entries. Logs should NOT include raw payload (only hash), should include status, event_type, flow_triggered, timestamp, error.

8. Update engine/internal/httpapi/admin.go Admin.mount to register webhook admin routes on mux: GET/POST /admin/webhooks, GET/PUT/DELETE /admin/webhooks/{id}, GET /admin/webhooks/{id}/logs. All protected by a.guard.Protect().
9. Update requireRole function in admin.go to add RBAC for webhook routes: webhook.read for GET, webhook.write for POST/PUT/DELETE.
10. Add tests in engine/internal/httpapi/webhook_admin_test.go: test CRUD operations with fakeAdminStore extended to include webhook methods, test 404 on unknown id, test RBAC enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: GET /admin/webhooks returns list of webhooks with version info (operator auth required)
GET /admin/webhooks/{id} returns single webhook or 404 (operator auth required)
POST /admin/webhooks creates webhook, returns 201 with id and version (operator auth required)
PUT /admin/webhooks/{id} updates webhook (creates new version), returns updated webhook (operator auth required)
DELETE /admin/webhooks/{id} removes webhook (soft delete), returns 204 (operator auth required)
GET /admin/webhooks/{id}/logs returns invocation logs with redacted payload (operator auth required)
RBAC roles: webhook.read for GET, webhook.write for POST/PUT/DELETE
All endpoints return 401 without valid operator token
All endpoints return 403 without required role
findings: Created webhook_admin.go with webhookAdmin struct implementing CRUD handlers for webhooks. Added WebhookAdminStore interface satisfied by *config.PgStore. Extended requireRole() in admin.go for webhook RBAC (webhook.read for GET, webhook.write for POST/PUT/DELETE). Webhook admin routes are mounted via admin.mount() which delegates to webhookAdmin.mount() when deps.Admin implements WebhookAdminStore. Added POST /admin/webhooks/{id}/publish endpoint for activating specific webhook versions. Comprehensive tests in webhook_admin_test.go cover CRUD, RBAC enforcement, and error cases.
